title: Chaotic Sulfur
description: Craft gunpowder and unstable TNT with this "Chaos Cubed" Overhaul datapack.
body:
> Chaotic Sulfur is a small content overhaul for the “Chaos Cubed” update that introduces sulfur-based gunpowder crafting and brings back the classic Unstable TNT mechanic.

**Features:**

_New Ingredient:_ The Sulfur Lumps are a new material obtained by breaking sulfur blocks, similar to how flint is obtained from gravel.

|             |Silk Touch |Disenchanted |Fortune I |Fortune II |Fortune III |
| ----------- |---------- |------------ |--------- |---------- |----------- |
| Probability |0%         |10%          |33,3%     |66,6%      |100%        |

_Gunpowder Recipe:_

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1551037/description_013b0c08-6094-4e41-a0a3-7f9969ce3a15.png)

_Unstable TNT:_ Explodes when broken, but its unstable state can be removed using a brush.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1551037/description_d7b61d2d-6a1e-4f3e-94e4-f9b5e3d1e865.png)

_Other Recipes:_

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1551037/description_3da59a7c-25b3-4099-aa08-487b3c02f52d.png) ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1551037/description_f468c31c-4f64-4b4b-b5da-554a0994d722.png)

**Installation:** This datapack also works as a texture pack, so you need to install it in both your resource packs folder and your world's datapacks folder.
